description: One note per included paper: state/notes/<id>.json

fields.id: paper id from state/corpus.json (also the BibTeX key)
fields.title: paper title
fields.problem: 2 to 3 sentences: what problem the paper solves and why it matters
fields.key_idea: 2 to 3 sentences: the main idea or insight
fields.approach: 3 to 5 sentences: how the system or method works
technique_family: short reusable labels, e.g. expert offloading, expert prefetching, speculative decoding
system_layer: one or more of: algorithm, model, kernel, runtime, scheduler, memory, compiler, cluster, hardware
fields.target_setting: e.g. single GPU, multi-GPU, edge, serving cluster, training

metrics: e.g. throughput, TPOT, P99 latency, memory

limitations: stated by the authors or clearly visible in the evaluation
